content: रूपवत् {%a.%} .²1 Having form or colour. .²2 Bodily, corporeal. .²3 Embodied. .²4 Handsome, beautiful. .²5 (Mīmāṃsā) Possessed of रूप {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} where are mentioned द्रव्य, देवता <ab>etc.</ab> which form the रूप of a sacrificial act; स एष रूपवतां संनिधावरूपः शब्दः श्रूयमाणः समुदायवाचकः समधिगतः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 4. 1</ls>. .{@-ती@} A beautiful woman.
